messages:
Sam: heads up 1 — courier dropped a heavy crate at the lobby desk labeled 'demo-samples' but no recipient listed.
frontdesk-bot: [Automated] Package received: demo-samples (Crate). Stored in Overflow Locker B2. Holding period: 48h.
Priya: that might be for Anita's user research session at 3pm? Anita, did you expect anything?
Anita: yes that's ours, thanks. i emailed vendor but note i'm not on site until 2:40pm. can someone move it to MR-B and leave a sticky?
Leo: i can grab it at 1:45pm and move to MR-B. also, heads-up: two external participants arriving for 3pm - can we have visitor badges ready? names: Tom Alvarez, Priyanka Singh.
Sam: added to badge queue. frontdesk-bot will create them now.
frontdesk-bot: Badge reservation created: Tom Alvarez; Priyanka Singh. Pickup: Front Desk. Expiry: 4 hours.
Priya: small ask: can we reserve the second bench in the lobby for guests? it's away from main walkway.
Anita: yes please. if Leo could set that bench aside and put a 'Reserved - Guests' sign, that would be perfect.
Leo: will do. also note the crate is heavy ~45lbs, i'll use the dolly.
Sam: tagging facilities @facilities for the dolly reminder and an extra folding chair just in case.
frontdesk-bot: Update: Package status changed to 'reserved' by Leo at 13:50. Note: moved to Meeting Room B per request.
Anita: amazing thank you all. i'll confirm with vendor pickup if anything else shows up.
Priya: thanks team! :sparkles:
Sam: closing loop from people-ops side 1. badges printed, crate in MR-B, bench reserved. :white_check_mark:
